title: Learn the venture's money
goal: The venture's accounts, recurring spend and ownership are recorded, and the money summary gives cash, burn and runway with every figure citing the records it came from.

steps.do: Read the money accounts, spend register, budget and ownership record, and list what is missing, most needed first.
Ask the founder which bank, card and payment accounts the venture uses and their balances today.

consider.why: Balances say how long the money lasts.
consider.when: A bank, card or payment account in the venture's name already exists.

steps.do: Ask which subscriptions and recurring costs the venture pays, and draft one spend register entry for each.

consider.why: Recurring costs renew whether anyone watches them or not.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later, or the venture already pays for a subscription or recurring cost.

steps.do: Ask who owns the venture and in what shares, and record it; any change to it goes to the founder.

consider.why: Who owns the venture decides who must agree to every change of control.
consider.when: The business is in Scale or later, or anyone besides one founder owns or will own a share, or the venture is an LLC or corporation or takes outside money.

steps.do: Draft a base budget for the next 12 months from the spend register, the accounts and what the founder expects to earn, one line per category and month, each citing its record or marked as an assumption, and ask the founder to confirm the categories.

consider.why: A budget shows when the money runs out.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later, or the venture has spend or accounts to plan.

steps.do: Write the money summary: cash, monthly burn and months of runway projected from the budget, each figure citing the records it came from. Set source to records and as_of to the time you write it, and leave synced_at out, since it is only for a summary that came from a sync.

consider.why: One money summary lets every function read where money stands.
consider.when: The business is in Beachhead or later, or the venture has accounts, spend or a budget.

done_criteria.check: Does every figure in the money summary cite the account or spend entries it came from?
